# Sunday Live Scan in Alameda County

**Who this is for:** You have a California *Request for Live Scan Service* form (BCIA 8016) from an employer, licensing board, school, or agency, and you need fingerprints **this Sunday** in Alameda County (Oakland, Berkeley, Alameda, Hayward, Fremont, San Leandro, Union City, Dublin, Livermore, Pleasanton, Newark, or anywhere else on the county dump).

**Not for:** TSA PreCheck / IdentoGO (different vendor). Out-of-state ink cards unless the shop’s own page says they roll FD-258. I-9s or notary work. Saturday-only rollers (see the skip table). UPS *store* hours that say open Sunday.

**Updated:** 2026-08-31  
**Query this page answers:** “Sunday Live Scan Alameda County”

## How this was verified

Rows below are **only** shops on the California DOJ Public Live Scan Sites list for **Alameda County** whose DOJ hours include **Sunday** or **Weekends** (weekends include Sunday). Walk-in Sunday and appointment-only Sunday are split into two tables. A shop that is Saturday-only on DOJ is not a Sunday roller, even if the UPS locator says “open 7 days.”

- Primary: [CA DOJ Live Scan locations — Alameda County](https://oag.ca.gov/fingerprints/locations) (accessed 2026-08-31)
- Per-location DOJ pages linked in each row (accessed 2026-08-31)
- Operator pages used only for gotchas and for fields DOJ left blank (phones). They never created a row.

**Nobody was called.** DOJ itself says to confirm hours and fees before you go. If a cell could not be verified, it is marked **UNVERIFIED**.

## Go / no-go before you leave

1. **Form first.** The requesting agency fills the ORI / OCA / job title. A blank 8016 from the internet is usually rejected. DOJ: [Applicants](https://oag.ca.gov/fingerprints/applicants).
2. **Unexpired photo ID.** Expired IDs are not accepted (DOJ applicants page, accessed 2026-08-31).
3. **Two fees.** (a) **Rolling fee** = the shop’s price in the table. (b) **DOJ/FBI processing** = extra, amount depends on *your* agency. Some agencies put a billing number on the form so you only pay rolling. There is no honest single “Live Scan costs $X” number. Several Sunday rows also say **additional service fees may apply**.
4. **Cash vs card.** It varies. Naka Tax lists billing / cash / checks on DOJ — **no cards**. Santosh is cash / cashier’s check only. GM Defense lists no cash. DOJ: “check for any restrictions on method of payment, such as cash or money order only.”
5. **Store hours ≠ fingerprint hours.** This is the page’s main gotcha. UPS locator pages advertise “open 7 days” and notary 7 days. That is shipping. Live Scan Sunday hours are the DOJ column. Telegraph / Piedmont / Grand UPS stores are open Sunday for packages and **not** on DOJ for Sunday Live Scan.

Official state / FBI processing examples (not your total; purpose codes differ): DOJ Custodian of Records page lists **state $32.00** and **federal $17.00** for that specific COR submission ([source](https://oag.ca.gov/fingerprints/custodian), accessed 2026-08-31). The statewide [Applicant Fingerprint Processing Fees PDF](https://www.oag.ca.gov/sites/all/files/agweb/pdfs/fingerprints/forms/fees.pdf) is still labeled **“As of August 17, 2012 — Subject to Change.”** Do not budget from it.
